purpose: Generated visual references; live game sprites unchanged.
limitations: Generated illustrative views, not dimensionally verified orthographic drawings. Sprite is an enlarged pixel-style reference; exact native 120px resolution and 30–35 color count unverified.
model_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a technical orthographic MODEL SHEET of the user's orange KANGAROO MECH from Image 1, keeping its design exactly with the explicit corrections below taking priority. FIVE full-body poses in a clean spacious landscape layout: four standard views (true side facing RIGHT, true front, true back, orthographic front-right three-quarter) PLUS one extra right-facing three-quarter pose showing the stomach cannon deployed. All FIVE at the SAME SCALE with aligned height guides implicit, generous room around every silhouette. No perspective: side/front/back are true level-camera elevations, three-quarter is parallel projection. Flat even lighting, clean cel shading only 2–3 tones per material, dark colored seams between armor plates. Uniform flat neutral grey background, no vignette, text, labels, logos or ground lines.

Critical current design:
1. Rounded ORANGE POUCH covering the LOWER BELLY, clearly distinct from the hatch above it. Orange torso consists of FLAT CHAMFERED ARMOR SLABS with clean broad faces, not organic curves or sculpted abs.
2. A STOMACH HATCH ABOVE THE POUCH conceals a PIRATE-STYLE IRON CANNON. In the FOUR standard views hatch is CLOSED, cannon completely hidden, pouch remains visible beneath hatch. In ONLY the fifth pose the hatch is flipped UP on its top hinge and the FAT short charcoal iron cannon with thick reinforcing BANDS has swung out to project FORWARD horizontally from the STOMACH opening, ABOVE the pouch. Big round dark muzzle. Show a practical internal pivot/cradle, but nothing dangles down. Cannon is not a minigun, rifle, orange barrel, groin gun or a hand-held weapon.
3. NOTHING hanging below the belly between the legs. EXACTLY TWO mirrored kangaroo hind legs, both feet planted side by side at the SAME fore/aft position and a LITTLE BACK from the belly. Neutral symmetrical stance, no stepping pose. Belly underside is clean; no third leg, hanging central tube or appendage.
4. Hip BOOSTERS, rocket POD and shoulder GUN are MID GREY, not orange or black. Keep their reference placements and compact shapes, short small forelimbs at upper torso as shown.
5. Tall paired orange ear blades, orange tapered muzzle, tiny flat cyan eyes, stacked dark grey long mechanical neck. Broad orange torso and haunch armor. Bent dark articulated rear legs, long orange feet. Segmented orange tail slopes DOWN BEHIND the mech with dark bands and a small grey tip.
6. Round JOINT DISCS have DARK RIM, MID-GREY FACE, and ONE WHITE HIGHLIGHT each. No all-silver or glowing hubs.
Follow reference silhouette, back panel arrangement, limb proportions and small mechanical connections. No added weapons or redesign beyond the explicitly described current corrections. No fur or skin, extra ears, glow, bloom, atmospheric lighting or perspective distortion. Make the closed-hatch standard views and the extra deployed-cannon view unambiguously consistent versions of the same machine.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE right-facing game battle sprite of the user's current ORANGE KANGAROO MECH in the style of GBA Zoids Legacy battle sprites. Image 1 is the original design reference; Image 2 is the corrected construction sheet, especially for pouch, hatch, mirrored feet and joint discs. Respect these explicit current features over any ambiguity in the images.

Full-body sprite, camera about 18 degrees above ground and turned 20 degrees toward viewer from right-facing profile. Native pixel-art design about 120 pixels tall, enlarged nearest-neighbor for presentation; aim for 30–35 colors in long ramps, upper-left light, material-colored dark outlines NEVER pure black. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, readable chamfered flat armor planes, controlled highlights, no antialiasing, painterly blur or smooth 3D rendering. Flat uniform neutral grey background, one thin straight VIOLET ground line at feet, no vignette, text, logo or scenery.

Exact machine design: orange long pointed kangaroo muzzle, TWO tall slender orange ears, tiny flat cyan eyes, exposed stacked dark grey mechanical neck, broad orange torso built from flat CHAMFERED SLABS. Rounded orange POUCH over LOWER BELLY. A separate stomach HATCH ABOVE the pouch is CLOSED in this sprite, hiding a fat banded pirate-style iron cannon entirely inside. Keep hatch visibly distinct from the pouch; do not show the deployed cannon or anything below belly. Absolutely NOTHING dangling from belly, no central third leg or gun between legs. EXACTLY TWO symmetrical mirrored bent kangaroo hind legs, both feet side by side and a little BACK behind belly, same fore/aft position, not a stepping pose. Grey mechanical links, orange segmented feet. Hip BOOSTERS, rocket POD and shoulder GUN are MID GREY, with modest steel highlights, NOT orange and not black. Preserve asymmetrical shoulder hardware placements as in the reference, and compact upper forearms. Round joint DISCS: DARK RIM, MID-GREY FACE, ONE WHITE HIGHLIGHT per disc. Long thick segmented orange tail slopes DOWN BEHIND, dark bands between sections, small steel tip. Preserve original proportions and panel arrangement. No new guns or head antennas, boxing gloves, organic skin/fur, extra limbs, glow, bloom or eye light spill. A beautifully finished faithful handheld-game sprite reference, not a new character design.
